# when

Run an indented block whenever its condition is true.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.when` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | DCode Conditional |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `when <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `when condition:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Example

```lua
when condition:
    -- body
```
